evidence.quote: 7 Semester : 3.5 years standard period of study
The language of instruction is German, with some classes held in English.
The main studies (the third semester to the seventh semester) are taught in German.
Tuition fee : 1500 € Tuition fee : Concerns students form non-EU/EEA countries only
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR

notes: The DAAD and university pages for this programme do not specify a non-EU application deadline; the application period 'Mid-May until mid-September' (DAAD) is a general window without year or applicant-specific wording, so no intake date was recorded. The university page states the programme has direct enrolment; the general bachelor application instructions mention recognition of international certificates via Uni-Assist or Studienkolleg Konstanz, but the programme page does not explicitly say a foreign-diploma applicant applies via Uni-Assist. The application channel was set to 'de-university-direct' because the programme page says 'you can enroll directly for a place on the program' and the application portal is eCampus. The teaching language is recorded as both German and English because the programme structure lists English in the first two semesters and German from the third semester onwards; a single language could not be isolated.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 79 Reading: 18 Listening: 17 Speaking: 20 Writing: 17 Cambridge English Qualifications: B2 First IELTS Academic: 6

note.fr: Les diplômés étrangers doivent d'abord faire reconnaître leur certificat de fin d'études secondaires par le Studienkolleg Konstanz ou par Uni-Assist. Sans cette reconnaissance, la candidature ne sera pas prise en compte.
note.en: Foreign applicants must first have their school-leaving certificate recognized by Studienkolleg Konstanz or by Uni-Assist. Without this recognition, the application will not be considered.

evidence.quote: Without certificate recognition, your application will unfortunately not be considered.

note.fr: Les candidats titulaires d'un diplôme étranger doivent soumettre leurs documents au Studienkolleg – Center for International Students de Constance ou à uni-assist pour vérifier l'équivalence de leur diplôme.
note.en: Applicants with a foreign certificate must submit their documents to the Studienkolleg – Center for International Students in Konstanz or to uni-assist to verify the equivalence of their qualification.

evidence.quote: In order to examine the equivalence of their university entrance qualifications, applicants should submit their documents to the "Studienkolleg – Center for International Students" in Konstanz or to uni-assist.

note.fr: L'admission dans cette filière est possible via un examen d'entrée spécifique à l'université. Contactez l'université pour connaître la procédure et les documents exigés.
note.en: Admission to this programme is possible via a university-specific entrance examination. Contact the university to learn about the procedure and required documents.

note.fr: Le programme exige une maîtrise de l'allemand pour réussir la suite des études (les 3e à 7e semestres sont en allemand). Informez-vous auprès de l'université sur le niveau requis et les certificats acceptés.
note.en: The programme requires German proficiency to successfully complete the later part of the studies (3rd to 7th semesters are taught in German). Check with the university about the required level and accepted certificates.

evidence.quote: Thus, a successful completion of the German language course is required.

note.fr: La filière a une période d'essai pour les candidats internationaux dont le diplôme ne permet pas l'admission directe (voir les détails sur le site de l'université).
note.en: The programme has a probationary study period for international applicants whose qualification does not allow direct admission (see details on the university website).

evidence.quote: The probationary study period at HHN lasts two semesters and can be extended to up to four semesters.

note.fr: Le programme exige un entretien oral ou un test (par ex. TestAS ou IELTS) dans le cadre d'une procédure d'admission spécifique. Vérifiez les modalités exactes auprès de l'université.
note.en: The programme requires an oral test or written test (e.g. TestAS or IELTS) as part of a specific admission procedure. Check the exact modalities with the university.

evidence.quote: To be able to enroll, you must pass one of the written tests listed below with the respective minimum score, as well as the oral test (depending on the language of your desired degree program) with the corresponding minimum score.
